_comment: blacklist: listed entries bypass the tunnel. whitelist: only listed entries use the proxy, and the sing-box config must set route.final to that proxy; everything else goes direct. An empty whitelist sends every destination direct and does not need route.final. A whitelist ip_cidr that overlaps tun route_exclude_address is removed from that exclude so the packet can enter the adapter. domain_suffix google.com matches that domain and every subdomain level (www.google.com, a.b.google.com); a leading *. is optional and is stripped. A bare IP becomes /32. process_path is case-sensitive. No trailing commas. _example is not applied.
